intent: Let industry Memory Campaign Leads use one ChatGPT invocation for up to four sequential map-driven probe cycles while preserving a complete S-to-H handoff after every probe and recovering unfinished work first on the next invocation.
rationale_summary: CAP-0006 already owns map-driven blind Memory probing and novelty/negative-space stop logic, CAP-0009 owns S-to-H interruption recovery, and CAP-0010 owns isolated workstream routing. Four serial completed cycles extend invocation throughput without adding parallel probes, a new cursor schema or another coordination layer; interruption recovery remains prior to any new task.
